Wednesday Wheelers (Charles River Wheelers)

Cambridge, MA · Road

Wednesday Wheelers (Charles River Wheelers) is a road group ride in Cambridge, MA. It rolls every Wednesday at 10:00 am from Varies every week (see the event page).

For visitors

CRW rides are open to guests for up to two rides a year before joining. Register on the event page. Helmet required. Start location changes weekly.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15-17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Wheelers (Charles River Wheelers) group ride

A midweek daytime ride through the western suburbs, sometimes north or south, with a lunch stop. The leader changes weekly and the group stays together. Rolling pace is about 13 mph with 30 to 40 miles. In winter the group may swap in a walk or a ski.
